method: Actual local JPEG/bug-crop viewing, both timing and situation lenses. Cached ffmpeg frames reused; missing boundary frames range-extracted. Root checked all PA11-12 frames, PA13 decisions/releases, PA14 wide shots/bugs/release, PA15 changed releases and decision spot checks; subagents checked every PA13-15 pitch.
limitations: Manual selected-frame review, not automatic synchronization. Continuity sampled at up to 2.25-second gaps in PA11 and at most 1-second gaps in PA13-15; interruptions between samples are not excluded. Release uncertainty is +/-0.15 s, not a statistical confidence interval. No independent human inter-rater study. Same-game development data; OCR template-source PAs remain excluded.
